priorities.summary: Code injection (CWE-94) in SAP S/4HANA's Manage Substitution/Validation Rules: an authenticated attacker with specific business privileges submits crafted input that escapes the scripting language and executes as arbitrary ABAP code, leading to full system compromise.

iFlytek Astron Agent below 1.1.2: the default workflow code-node path uses an unsandboxed LocalExecutor, letting an authenticated low-privilege tenant run root Python in the core-workflow container and bypass tenant checks to read or modify other tenants' data.

Relative path traversal (CWE-23) in Cisco Secure Email Gateway's AMP File Reputation: a remote unauthenticated attacker sends a crafted email attachment, enabling arbitrary file write and root command execution with no user interaction. CISA KEV-listed Oct 14, 2026 with active exploitation confirmed.

model.name: Meta Muse Spark Open
model.summary: Meta released the open weights of Muse Spark Open, an 816B-total / 42B-active MoE model with a 1M-token context — built for coding and agentic work and billed by Meta as the most capable US open-weight model to date. It was co-optimized with Apple MLX to run on two M5 Ultra Mac Studios, a surprise Meta-Apple collaboration.
